lines.say: 53,319 stars / for one idea: / teach your coding agent / marketing.
It's a collection / of AI agent skills / for marketing tasks. / They run in / Claude Code, Codex, / Cursor and Windsurf.
Each skill / is a markdown file / with specialized knowledge / and a workflow / for one task.
One skill / is the foundation: / product-marketing. / Every other skill / checks it first / to understand / your product, / audience / and positioning.
Then you just ask: / help me optimize / this landing page / for conversions. / Your agent checks / your product context, / then uses / the cro skill.
Ask for homepage copy, / and it uses copywriting. / Ask for GA4 tracking, / and it uses analytics.
There are 50 skills, / from SEO audits / and pricing / to churn prevention / and cold email.
A single skill / holds 140 / SaaS marketing ideas.
There's even / a marketing council: / a simulated board / of advisors.
The library is free / and MIT-licensed, / and it's been forked / 7,937 times.
Installing takes / one command: / npx skills add / coreyhaines31/marketingskills.
Built by Corey Haines. / Try it / on your next landing page.
